details_api.description:
Enter a prefix that uniquely identifies the openWB.
*If you migrate from MQTT to the API interface, enter the MQTT root topic here and the integration creates the sensors etc. with the same IDs.*

Adjust the IP address and select the device type.
For the device types counter, chargepoint, PV system and battery, the device ID is also required. You can find it on the status tab of your openWB.
details_api.title: API settings for openWB

data.DEVICEID: Device ID in openWB (-> status tab)

details_mqtt.description:
Enter the MQTT root topic under which the openWB can be reached on your MQTT server and select the device type.
For the device types counter, chargepoint, PV system and battery, the device ID is also required. You can find it on the status tab of your openWB.
For the device type wallbox, enter the device ID 0.
details_mqtt.title: MQTT settings for openWB

chargepoint.description:
Enter the max. charging power of your wallbox (required) and the list of vehicles (optional) as a comma-separated list.
Enter the vehicle list in the following format:

	vehicle ID=vehicle name,vehicle ID=vehicle name

Make sure that the vehicle names match the values configured in the openWB *exactly*. Only then are the vehicles shown correctly in the vehicle selection list.
You can find the vehicle ID on the status tab of the openWB.

unsupported_device_type.description:
The entry "{title}" uses the device type {device_type}. This device type is no longer supported by the integration. No entities are created for this entry any more.

Please delete the entry "{title}". You can build totals (for example the total power of all chargepoints) with Home Assistant helpers, such as the "Sensor group" helper or a template sensor.
